verdict.rationale: There is no llms.txt or agent-targeted documentation endpoint in the evidence. The closest match is that `foreloop init` installs a task-executor skill into the checkout, which 'teaches an agent working there how to claim and report on Foreloop tasks.' Task contracts also carry team skills into each run, giving agents product-specific guidance in an agent-consumable form. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, agent-oriented or markdown docs an agent can be pointed at by URL, and independent corroboration that agents can use the docs directly.
